reviews.text:
I was waiting to write this review because of how impressed I am. first, I was on vacation while my pool got remodeled+ plastered and I cant explain to you how stressed and worried I was. However, Patty was really helpful making this easy on us. I will start with the very first visit to get a quote, patty came to our place after working hours so me and my wife can be there and discuss pool remodeling project, she showed us samples and explained all the differences between each of them and helped us chose what's best for us and our budget. on top of that we discussed a possible remodeling options and how its done. The pricing was really competitive and fitted our budget perfectly while doing everything we need to do to our pool.

later on we had to delay our project many times for many reasons but Patty was really understanding and helped us all the way. My mother in law was staying at our place while we were on vacation and she said it was a hassle free project. they where on time and finished on time with an amazing results. the full project took 3 days only. Patty never failed to impress as she helped us also to find someone to fix our pool equipment and do the start up cleaning in a very busy season.

Thank you guys for all the hard work and I will defiantly do business with you every time.
reviews.author: Zee Miehiar

reviews.text: Patty and her team did an amazing job!! Our pool was in terrible condition, very rough old plaster, a huge crack and some smaller ones. They put staples in, tiled, replastered, put my cute little tile stamps in, replaced my light housing and bulb for me and helped me get it working. Best part is, they didn’t rip me off! I had quotes from other companies for more than double what they charged me.
reviews.author: Lauren Groves (LP)

reviews.text:
If I could give zeros stars, it still would be too many. If you are thinking you will save money by using this company, DO NOT DO IT!! You absolutely will not save money. I hired them to replaster my pool. They were off and on with poor or no communication. Then they plastered and did not use the correct amount of dye so my pool is the wrong color. I told them they were doing the wrong color but the problem is that they did not know how to use the product. Next, they don’t tell you up front that they don’t do any brushing or chemical restart. And that is a big deal. It’s expensive to hire someone to do this and it’s important that it’s done right. Next the pool is rough. There spots that feel like walking on sharp rocks. There are white stains everywhere. We have brushed for weeks and still have stains and rough spots. Then, when they cleaned up, they put plaster down my yard drainage. I’m paying to have that unclogged too. At the end they took my money and disappeared. I have not contacted them because I cannot deal with their unreliability and destruction anymore.
Whatever their answer to this review may be, they did more than a poor job. They gave me more problems than those with which I started.
Do not try to save money. You will be sorry.
6/6/23 - I need to add that when your plaster is done poorly, it is susceptible to black algae. We’ve had repeated problems with it now.
reviews.author: Angela

reviews.text: Awesome experience with this company! Antonio and his crew did an outstanding job! Prices were exceptional for the work performed!
reviews.author: Jeff Bishop

reviews.text: Had plaster, coping, and tile redone- an entire remodel from an ugly and old pool.  They really did a wonderful job
reviews.author: J R

reviews.text: Awesome work.  We love our pool again after a much needed update.  Our pool is 22 years old and it was time for resurfacing and several repairs.  They are very knoweledgable, great communictors, showed up when they say they would. Highly recommend them.  Family owned business and they own their equipment so very affordable for those on a budget with these large projects.
reviews.author: Alma Miller

reviews.text:
Amazing job by Antonio and his team. Patty was great to coordinate with and brought samples of the plaster color to our home which was so helpful.
They came quickly and got the job done to our complete satisfaction. We’ve already recommended them to our neighbors.
reviews.author: Katelyn Tipton

reviews.text: A wonderful family run business!  Communication was great, finished ahead of schedule and the results are stunning! We replaced plaster, coping stones and tile.   If I could give 10 stars I would. Very highly recommend for any pool work.
reviews.author: Diana Elwell

reviews.text: Our pool was transformed from old and run down to absolutely beautiful in only a few days. Patty answered all my many questions and had great ideas. Antonio has a perfectionist attitude that really shows in the final product. The whole team was very efficient. Thank you so much!!
reviews.author: Mitzi Wood

reviews.text:
**DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!
Santonio’s re-plastered our pool and spa however the day after the job our spa would not hold water.   I let them know and they told me it HAD to be an issue with the valves.  Well I replaced the valves even though they were fine and the spa continued to leak completely dry.

Finally they sent a repairman who found that the spa drain was not plastered correctly causing leaks.  He attempted to epoxy the gaps and left.  I called Patty to let her know the issue and she said she would take care of that as it was covered by warranty.  Unfortunately the spa continued to drain as the repair was not performed correctly and additionally the pool would not hold water as we discovered the return jet also had the same issue – they did not plaster that correctly either!.  I let them know both were still broken and I hired my own repair company as their repairman would not come back out.  (in the meantime my water bill is close to $500 as I had to keep water in the pool.)  He found that the repair was not performed correctly and repaired it.

I let Santionios know and now all of a sudden they said it’s NOT covered by warranty b/c they don’t want to pay me for the repairs.  So, they did not do the job correctly, admitted that it was covered under warranty but won’t cover the repairs.  Nothing but lies from this company.  They’ll take your money but won’t warranty their work.  Lesson learned – don’t use the cheap guys – go somewhere else to get the job done right!
reviews.author: Brad R

reviews.text: Santonio’s Pool Plaster is really great. I have done my pool resurfacing from them, they have done excellent jobs, their all crews are very experienced and very good. I recommend their job. Thanks a lot Mr Santonio and his team.
reviews.author: Mahbub Haque

reviews.text: Very good and reliable company. We had them replaster and retile our pool. Punctual and finished in one week. Very friendly, reliable, good quality. We recommend Santonio's without hesitation.
reviews.author: Jorge Vivar

reviews.text:
We first contacted Patty in mid January and explained the remodel work being performed on our pool with an anticipated late March early April installation. They provided pricing for both white plaster and Diamond Brite surfacing. As we neared installation date I called and texted Patty numerous times. When she did finally respond she acted like she didn’t know me and tried to say we had originally set up a January install. When I corrected her she began to tell me I was unprofessional and that’s she didn’t normally answer calls in the evening. I had tried her at least 10 times during normal business hours and she never answered. She then tried to claim she didn’t get my texts…. Trying to stay on board with them we did a reset and agreed again to an April 11 start date. I attempted to contact her numerous times from late March to early April to no avail. Her voice mail was also full. Finally in the week of April 4 she answered and said she was in Mexico and had an opening the week of April 19th. We set up a meeting for April 19th. I took a day of vacation specifically to meet her. She never contacted me or showed up. On April 20 we terminated the verbal only agreement and have moved on.
We wish them luck but they must improve their communication skills as far as I am concerned.
reviews.author: Robert Farrow

reviews.text: Great job!! Very pleasant people to work with. I highly recommend Santonio Pools to everyone thinking about a beautiful pool remodel. We are so pleased.
reviews.author: Juan Pacheco

reviews.text: I had an emergency with my plaster (done by another company) and the  owner Patty took my call on a Saturday afternoon and answered all my questions and walked me through solutions- she was incredibly knowledgeable and we will be working with this company to remedy our issues in the future! Thank you so much for your help:)
reviews.author: Jennifer LeFevre

reviews.text: Did an excellent job on Diamond Brite replastering,deco o seal the outer pool, coping repair all in two days and the best price than the other pool company, thank you  Antonio and Patty.   Lloyd’Jumbo’ Nakamura 🤙🏻

data.summary: Reviews show a mix of highly satisfied and deeply dissatisfied customers. The negative reviews are specific and credible, pointing to real issues with communication and occasional workmanship. The positive reviews are generally detailed and span years, suggesting authentic happy customers. The pattern indicates a potentially inconsistent contractor, not a fake review farm.
fake_signals: Some 5-star reviews are generic and lack detail
Owner response to 1-star review is defensive and shifts blame
authentic_signals: Specific project details in positive reviews (staples, tile stamps, light housing)
Varied writing styles and timeframes (reviews span 6 years)
Negative reviews contain specific, credible complaints (spa drain leak, wrong dye color)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google and BBB ratings are available, and they are not contradictory. BBB A+ indicates good complaint handling, aligning with a decent Google score.
